body: I confirmed that this is a bug, the `plain` highlighter always sorts fragments by score. The fix is [trivial](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/3b696828ada5953bb1669b972a353736383edf08/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/search/fetch/subphase/highlight/PlainHighlighter.java#L159) but I wonder if there is a specific reason why you don't use the `unified` highlighter, which is the default in `6.x` ?

Hi @jimczi

I have tested same with latest Elasticsearch version **(7.11.1)**. Order attribute is not working with Plain highlighter.

Hi @jimczi  , 
Could you please let us know as to when this bug is going to be fixed and release plan for the same. We are depending on this feature and developed features using plain highlighter. We appreciate any help to get this resolved as soon as possible.

issue.title: Fix Plain Highlighter ordering for `none`

labels.name: :Search Relevance/Highlighting
labels.description: How a query matched a document

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
The plain highlighter should order the fragments by order of appearance by
default, but sorts them by score internally. This fix changes the sorting
comparator in case ordering by score is not selected (the default) and adds
testing around this.

Closes #58236
